purpose: Teach: 知識人/会派/替わり/積ま/計っ/常用/手作業/シード

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、地域の知識人に、相談しまわった日々、懐かしい。
lines.en: Those days consulting with local scholars when we were starting out—I miss them.
lines.style: Slow, measured pace. Warm remembrance surfaces in the voice. Settle into the memory on the trailing syllable. Quiet authority of someone looking back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。当時、業界に、対立する会派、ありましたよね。
lines.en: Yes. Back then, there were rival factions in the industry, weren't there?
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Steady, attentive tone. Lean in slightly—showing genuine interest in his account, not just politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 息子の替わりに、孫に、教えたいことも、いっぱいある。
lines.en: I have so much I want to teach my grandson—things I couldn't teach my son.
lines.style: Tender, almost hesitant. A weight of regret underneath, but softened by hope. Pause before 'grandson' like he's feeling the importance of the moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。倉庫に、創業初期の在庫、まだ積まれていますよ。
lines.en: Yes. Early stock from the founding years is still stacked in the warehouse.
lines.style: Grounded, observational tone. Slight shift to something more concrete—moving from memory to present reality. Respectful, not pushing, just stating what endures.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 生涯売上、しっかり計って、誇りを持て。
lines.en: Measure your lifetime sales carefully and wear that success with pride.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. This lands as wisdom, not instruction. Clear, deliberate pacing. The voice of someone who has earned the right to speak plainly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業時から常用しているスローガン、変えていません。
lines.en: Yes. We haven't changed the motto we've used since founding day.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Almost understated—the steadiness of someone maintaining what matters. No flourish, just presence and continuity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、すべて手作業で、組み立てたな、私たち。
lines.en: When we were founding it, we assembled everything by hand—all of us together.
lines.style: Warm reverie. Voice softens on the memory. Slight smile in the sound. The intimacy of 'us'—people long since gone. Trailing-off at the end, lost in it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。次のシード事業、私の代で、立ち上げます。
lines.en: Yes. In my time, I'll launch the next venture from the ground up.
lines.style: Steady resolve. A respectful inheritance of duty without arrogance. Weight of succession resting in his shoulders but carried with quiet readiness. Clear-eyed close.
